newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: U.N. rights body condemns Peru guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: U.N. rights body condemns Peru guerrillas.

text.p: The 53-nation United Nations Human Rights Commission on Wednesday condemned the leftist guerrillas who have been holding 72 hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima since December.

A statement from commission chairman Miroslav Somol of the Czech Republic described the rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement as "terrorist elements" and said hostage-taking anywhere violated human rights.
The commission, which this week opened its annual six-week session, expressed support for the efforts of the governments of Peru and Japan "to resolve the situation in a peaceful manner...."
The commission "strongly demands that the hostages taken in the residence of Japan in Lima and all other hostages held in any other country be released immediately," it said.
